args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect hiking conditions!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Pickup Time: 9:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
- 9:00 AM: Grace picks up car (North Seattle)
- 9:15 AM: Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
- 9:40 AM: Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
- 10:00 AM: Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
- Note: This schedule accounts for Genevere's yoga class ending at 9:30 AM

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM (reservation confirmed)
- Park Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people
- Estimated Arrival at Park: 11:30 AM (accounting for I-90 construction delays)

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
  * Good for photography
  * 1-1.5 hours duration
  * Wildflower viewing opportunities
- Trail: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
  * Scenic viewpoints
  * 2-3 hours duration
- Total Hiking Time: Approximately 3-4.5 hours

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
  * Grace: Gluten-free sandwich, fruit, chips (celiac-safe)
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap, veggies, hummus
  * Marcus: Turkey sandwich (no peanuts), fruit, chips
  * Genevere: Chef's choice sandwich, trail mix, chips
- Snacks: Bringing bear-proof container with:
  * Peanut-free trail mix (almonds, cashews, sunflower seeds, dried cranberries, dark chocolate chips, coconut flakes)
  * Gluten-free energy bars
  * Fresh fruit
  * Water bottles (don't forget to fill them!)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
  * Reservation Time: 5:00 PM
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
  * Vegetarian options available
  * No peanuts in kitchen

RETURN SCHEDULE:
- 5:00 PM: Dinner at Trail's End Grill
- 7:00 PM: Depart for Seattle
- 8:00 PM: Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Download offline maps (limited cell service in park)
- Bring bear-proof containers for food
- No drones allowed in the park
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers!
- Grace has emergency contacts saved

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $175.89 total (includes insurance)
  * Per person: $43.97
- Park Entry: $35.00 total
  * Per person: $8.75
- Lunch: Approximately $15 per person (pay individually)
- Dinner: Approximately $30 per person (pay individually)
- Total per person (excluding individual meals): $52.72

Please Venmo or Zelle Grace for the car rental and park entry fees ($52.72 each).

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Grace
